0022600108.text: The Bulls (1-1) host the Washington Wizards (1-0) in Chicago's third game of the 2026-27 season, with Chicago 3rd in the Central, 0.5 games back, and 8th in the East, while Washington is 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East. Chicago will be without Nic Claxton (hamstring), and Washington will be without AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery), and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve). The Bulls won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 119-108 win in Washington on April 9, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
